info.title: Open-Meteo Air Quality
info.description: Free, keyless air-quality API. Returns current pollutant concentrations, air-quality indices and UV for a coordinate pair. Same provider as the Open-Meteo forecast API but a different host, so it is its own namespace.

get.summary: Current air quality, pollutant levels and UV index for a coordinate pair
get.description: Returns air-quality readings for the given latitude/longitude. Ask for the fields you want via the `current` comma-separated selector, e.g. current=pm2_5,pm10,ozone,nitrogen_dioxide,us_aqi,european_aqi,uv_index. `us_aqi` bands: 0-50 good, 51-100 moderate, 101-150 unhealthy for sensitive groups, 151-200 unhealthy, 201-300 very unhealthy, 301+ hazardous. `european_aqi` bands: 0-20 good, 20-40 fair, 40-60 moderate, 60-80 poor, 80-100 very poor, 100+ extremely poor. Pollutant units are µg/m³.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone, or `auto` to use the timezone of the coordinates. Without it times are UTC.

200.description: Air-quality readings. `current` holds one value per requested field plus `time`.
